name: selfdriven.you
description: A personal operating system for the age of intelligence, built on four sustainable modes — Curious, Caring, Constructive, Chill — with a self-sovereign KERI/ACDC identity layer secured by WebAuthn passkeys.
tagline: A sustainable rhythm for living a fully human life in the age of intelligence.

skills.name: Curious
skills.description: Explore, ask, learn. The mode that opens doors — noticing what is actually there before you can care, build, or rest well.

skills.name: Caring
skills.description: Listen, hold space. The mode that keeps everything human — attention before advice.

skills.name: Constructive
skills.description: Build, ship, move. The mode that turns intention into something real — momentum beats motivation.

skills.name: Chill
skills.description: Pause, breathe, reset. The mode that makes the other three sustainable — rest is part of the work, not a reward earned after it.

skills.name: Where you at?
skills.description: A vibe check that helps you find which of the four modes you are in right now, and what to do next from there.

skills.name: Self-Sovereign Identity Builder
skills.description: A four-step wizard that generates an Ed25519 KERI autonomic identifier, encrypts the seed under a WebAuthn passkey (PRF / HKDF / AES-256-GCM), and registers witnesses — keys never leave the device.

compliance.keyManagement: Ed25519 seed generated in-browser, encrypted with a passkey-derived AES-256-GCM key, stored in IndexedDB; seed zeroed immediately after use
compliance.auditTrail: append-only KERI key event log (KEL), witnessed
